outcome: compliance of clinical staff with transfusion reaction monitoring and reporting procedures
cohort: The study cohort comprised all transfusion reaction forms received from July 1, 2017, to June 30, 2018, at the blood bank of Shaukat Khanum Memorial Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Lahore, Pakistan, covering 12,787 units dispensed and transfused.
finding: The incidence of transfusion reactions was low (0.39%), with allergic reactions being the most frequent type (48%), and there was good compliance with reporting procedures by clinical staff.
cross-section timing: Data collected from July 1, 2017, to June 30, 2018
